system_name.reference: this repository provides an easy-to-use toolkit for running and fine-tuning the state-of-the-art dense retrievers, namely **🚀RocketQA**.
system_name.matched_span: this repository provides an easy-to-use toolkit for running and fine-tuning the state-of-the-art dense retrievers, namely **🚀RocketQA**.

system_category.reference: By integrating this toolkit with [JINA](https://jina.ai/), 🚀RocketQA can help developers build an end-to-end retrieval system and question answering system with several lines of code.
system_category.matched_span: By integrating this toolkit with [JINA](https://jina.ai/), 🚀RocketQA can help developers build an end-to-end retrieval system and question answering system with several lines of code.

knowledge_representation.reference: Given a list of paragraphs and their corresponding titles (optional), returns their representations vectors encoded by model.

retrieval_mechanism.reference: In recent years, the dense retrievers based on pre-trained language models have achieved remarkable progress.
